description: Defines independent NSAZ comprehension cases for FormData and tests, missing contracts, schema placement, existing-schema Server Actions, and upload and webhook test overlaps.

cases.title: Independently review a FormData action and tests

executor_input.prompt: Independently review the FormData and RHF Server Action together with the supplied non-trivial tests.

context.content: The task creates, changes, or reviews a non-trivial integration, API, form-interaction, multi-branch Server Action, important-regression, concurrency, RLS, or multi-group test file.

criteria.description: The reader independently selects action, FormData and RHF, and validation-test procedures, uses parsed data, preserves the contract, and covers invalid, denied, and no-side-effect paths.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate selects references/server-actions-and-route-handlers.md, references/formdata-and-react-hook-form.md, and references/validation-test-matrix.md and skips references/schema-placement-and-design.md and references/uploads-webhooks-and-payments.md. The unsplit baseline has no future-reference obligation.
forbidden_behavior: Miss a matching procedure or select the external-payload procedure without an external-input trigger.

executor_input.prompt: Independently assess the requested collaborator persistence using the supplied repository contract.

context.content: The requested collaborator persistence, authorization, and RLS contract does not exist in the supplied repository evidence.

criteria.description: The reader independently applies the no-invention stop, identifies the missing database and RLS contract, selects the action procedure, and reports no success.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate selects references/server-actions-and-route-handlers.md and skips references/schema-placement-and-design.md, references/formdata-and-react-hook-form.md, references/uploads-webhooks-and-payments.md, and references/validation-test-matrix.md. The unsplit baseline has no future-reference obligation.
forbidden_behavior: Invent a contract or load unrelated schema, external-payload, FormData, or test procedures.

cases.title: Independently place a checkout schema and type

executor_input.prompt: Independently place a transformed reusable checkout schema and type.

criteria.description: The reader independently selects schema placement and design, classifies the reusable SSOT, uses z.input and z.output intentionally, and inspects callers before deciding the contract.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate selects references/schema-placement-and-design.md and skips references/server-actions-and-route-handlers.md, references/formdata-and-react-hook-form.md, references/uploads-webhooks-and-payments.md, and references/validation-test-matrix.md. The unsplit baseline has no future-reference obligation.
forbidden_behavior: Select action, FormData, external-payload, or test procedures without a corresponding task trigger.

cases.title: Independently review a JSON Server Action

executor_input.prompt: Independently review a JSON Server Action that uses an existing schema and changes no schema or test.

criteria.description: The reader independently selects the action and handler procedure and preserves parsing, authentication, authorization, mutation, and safe-response order without inventing schema or test work.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate selects references/server-actions-and-route-handlers.md and skips references/schema-placement-and-design.md, references/formdata-and-react-hook-form.md, references/uploads-webhooks-and-payments.md, and references/validation-test-matrix.md. The unsplit baseline has no future-reference obligation.
forbidden_behavior: Require schema-placement or validation-test procedures when neither schema nor test work is requested.

cases.title: Independently review upload and webhook handlers

executor_input.prompt: Independently review the upload and webhook Route Handlers together with the supplied non-trivial validation tests.

context.content: The task creates, changes, or reviews a non-trivial integration, API, form-interaction, multi-branch Server Action, important-regression, concurrency, RLS, or multi-group test file.

criteria.description: The reader independently selects external-payload, action and handler, and validation-test procedures and distinguishes shape, authenticity, Storage authorization, and database state.

expected_behavior: A migrated candidate selects references/uploads-webhooks-and-payments.md, references/server-actions-and-route-handlers.md, and references/validation-test-matrix.md and skips references/schema-placement-and-design.md and references/formdata-and-react-hook-form.md. Physical obligations remain within the NSAZ bundle. The unsplit baseline has no future-reference obligation.
forbidden_behavior: Impose cross-bundle physical references, give a schema-only answer, or permit an unsafe side effect.
